s: Pages merged: «في مثل هذا اليوم» moves from the home page to the Works page (otd.js); «رحلتي» joins «قوائمي» as «قوائمي ورحلتي» (lists.html#journey, journey.html sends there); «لقاءاته» becomes «سيرته ولقاءاته» — his life in six chapters from the timeline, with each period's interviews and, after him, the Legacy page's events, above the interviews

3D book on a book's and a series' page: as tall as its cover — the book is 300px wide and its height (--bk-h, 340–520px) follows the cover picture's proportions once it loads (a chosen edition's cover too), so tall and short covers are no longer cropped; every face, the page edges, the spine title and the buttons under it follow. The Works page's books keep 400px

Lasheen: «أشباح الموالد» had lost its cover — adding book nineteen moved the spin-off to the 20th place, so its page key became lasheen-x19 and no longer met its cover, edition and links under lasheen-x18. It is now kept at index 18 whatever follows, so its address stays book.html?id=lasheen-x18

StoriaPod: six of his Ida2at serial stories as audio dramas by the «رُواة» team — «عشر علامات»، «تنصت»، «هشام يخفي سرًا»، «معرض الموت»، «حكاية للأطفال فقط»، «سفاح المستنقعات» — in a new «قصصه على ستوريا بود» section of the Audio page, each with its cover and leading to its first episode in the blog archive; and «أشباح الموالد», the Lasheen spin-off's six-episode mini-drama, in the Lasheen rows and on the series page. StoriaPod gets its own chip in the Audio page's platform filter

Lasheen on StoriaPod: books one to four as audiobooks read by Mohamed Khamis (Kotopia), and «مسلسل لاشين (العهد)», the audio drama of book one by Karim Kandil (six episodes, 25 Sept – 30 Oct 2026) — on the Audio page's Lasheen rows with their lengths, on each book's cassette, in a «على ستوريا بود» block on the series page, and StoriaPod as an audio house on «دور النشر» with its logo

Lasheen: book nineteen «الفنارة العمياء» (Kotopia, 2026), with its cover and Abjjad source; and season 8 of «بعد منتصف الليل» on Audiohat, now airing — its first episode «المال والبنون» (45 min) on the Audio page with the season's art, and the series page's season 8 link corrected (it pointed at season 7's address)
Videos: a special episode of Ahmed Mourad's «ليل داخلي» (Radio Energy 92.1 FM) on him, with Ahmed El-Aidy and Tamer Ibrahim, days after his death (April 2018) — on «لقاءاته» and the Legacy videos

New page «ترجماته» (translations.html): what he put into Arabic — the six books he translated (Fight Club, Dermaphoria, The Kite Runner, Che, The Graveyard Book, Old Delights) with their covers and authors; the 77 issues of «روايات عالمية للجيب» he translated (#7–83), each with the novel and author it came from, the authors as chips that filter the covers (Wells 4, King 4, Conan Doyle 3, Grisham 3…); and the 10 of «رجفة الخوف» — 93 works from 47 authors. The band: the novels' own titles drifting past his Arabic ones, a quill between. In the phone menu, the footer's «اكتشف أكثر», the site search and the sitemap, with its own share card and structured data

In the papers: جريدة التجمع — «القطرات الأخيرة», his farewell to Ismail Diab, ran there in 2005 (Al-Dostor, 3 April 2026: dostor.org/5487566), now with its source in the blog archive; the paper gets its card on «في الصحف» (Al-Tagammu, newspaper), noting it was the Tagammu' party's paper where he first wrote on politics and public affairs (e3lam.com/704514, 20 June 2025)
Footer: a heading «صفحات الموقع» over the main pages, as «اكتشف أكثر» and «خلف الكواليس» have
Footer: «خلف الكواليس» back in the middle column, under «احفظ الموقع دون اتصال», in three short columns like «اكتشف أكثر» above it

Footer: «احفظ الموقع دون اتصال» now under «اكتشف أكثر», after لقاءاته and الجوائز; «خلف الكواليس» moves to the head of the column that says who made the site, its links in a line or two, the heading at the right

Footer, lower: the site's main pages and the publishers stay in the first column; the pages made from the data move under their own heading «اكتشف أكثر», above «خلف الكواليس», each group in three short columns — about eight rows where there were twelve; on tablets and phones the groups stay centred one under another

Awards cabinet, closer to the CodePen: a real wood-grain back (assets/img/awards/wood.webp, made for the site — planks of warm wood, tiling) with lighter planks for shelves, and the trophies redrawn in its manner — glossy outlined cups with curled handles and a star, a knotted stem, a black stepped base with three stars; gold for a win, silver for the shortlist, bronze for an honour (the other honours too), the stars lit by the same order; the hover a dark veil with what and when, as in the pen

Awards: the band above the headline is now a trophy cabinet, after the CodePen «Snake Trophies» — wooden shelves behind glass, the prizes on the top shelf (gold for a win, silver for the shortlist, bronze for an honour) and the other honours as medals below, each on a black pedestal with its year on a brass plate; a hover shows what it is and when, and a click goes to its entry below, lit a moment. Drawn in CSS and SVG, no outside pictures

3D figures: back to the original bronze models and pictures (the shape-worked patina undone), and the museum page removed — museum.html, its script, style and share card, and its places in the menus, footer, search, sitemap and offline list; each figure now lives only on its character's page (Refaat; Alaa and Bernadette)

3D figures: a cast bronze's finish instead of one flat colour — since the STL files carry no paint, tools/stl-to-glb.js works it out from the shape and paints it on the corners: dark patina settled in the folds, a little verdigris in the recesses, the raised parts worn lighter, and a slow mottle; less mirror-like. Both models rebuilt, their statue pictures and the museum's share card redone to match

3D figures: Refaat Ismail, and Alaa Abdel Azim with Bernadette, as bronze statues — the site's editor's Meshy AI figures, turned from 3D-printing files (8.8 MB, no colour) into 1.2 MB web models by tools/stl-to-glb.js (welded, simplified, smooth, upright, quantized, a bronze finish). figure3d.js shows the statue's picture on a lit pedestal and, only when «اعرض المجسم» is pressed, loads Google's model-viewer and the model to turn and zoom — and on a phone «ضعه في غرفتك» sets it on one's desk through the camera (AR: Scene Viewer, Quick Look). On Refaat's and Alaa's pages, and on a new page «المتحف» (museum.html) with both on pedestals, links to their pages and series, and how to view them; labelled an artistic impression, not an official work. In the footer, the phone menu, the sitemap and the site search, with its own share card and structured data

Legacy timeline: as the CodePen does it — an event's year waits under its picture, and as the event comes into focus it rises fully into the picture's bottom corner, in white, its foot on the bottom edge, the title rising after it

Legacy timeline: each event's year now stands under its picture, its foot on the picture's bottom edge, as in the CodePen the timeline follows — picture, year, title — larger, with a shadow to stay legible over the picture; an event with no picture keeps the year above its title

Legacy interviews: Sameh Fayez's interview with him in Al-Qahira newspaper, «أنا مجرد شخص يحاول تقديم حاجة مسلية», linked to the clipping posted on Facebook (sent by the site's editor; no copy found online); undated on the page, about late 2012 by the books it mentions — on the Legacy page and «لقاءاته»
Ghada Abdel Aal's photograph, sent by the site's editor — on her writer page and beside her words on «قالوا عنه»

Ghada Abdel Aal, the satirist and pharmacist of «عايزة أتجوز»: on «تأثروا به» and «قالوا عنه», worded no further than the sources — her VICE piece «أحمد خالد توفيق: أبانا الذي في طنطا لم يأتِ هذا العام» (17 February 2019), where she wrote that his marks shaped parts of «our» feelings, and Tawfik's column «كاساندرا من جديد» (التحرير, 31 March 2014) on the writing workshop of hers he sat in on, linked from her entry; a short life from Arabic Wikipedia. A writer's entry may now give its own summary line where the shelf's ("grew up reading him") would claim more than the source. Asked for by the site's editor; every claim checked at its source

Writers: Ismail Diab (1936–2005), the painter of the Egyptian Pocket Novels' covers — the first covers of Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a, Fantasia and Safari among them — on «رفاق الطريق» with a page of his own: his photograph and a short life from Arabic Wikipedia, Tawfik's words on his drawings, and a link to «القطرات الأخيرة», the column in which Tawfik mourned him (a writer's entry can now link to a page of the site). Sent by the site's editor

The eleven data pages, ready for search and sharing: each its own 1200×630 share card in the site's style (assets/img/og/<page>.jpg, with its own pictures — posters, translations, first editions, prizes) and alt text, og:type website, keywords of its own, and JSON-LD written into the page (a CollectionPage or WebPage about him, within the site, with its breadcrumb); «رحلتي» indexed and in the sitemap with the rest; and the site's own search now finds the site's pages by their names and what they hold («نتفليكس» finds «على الشاشة»)

Links to the seven new pages: «حول العالم», «على الشاشة», «جدار الأغلفة», «رحلتي», «الطبعات», «لقاءاته» and «الجوائز» in the footer after the data pages and in the phone menu, and in the sitemap («رحلتي», being personal, is not indexed)

New page «الجوائز» (awards.html): his five prizes and honours in his life and after it — the 2012 shortlist for Utopia in translation, the 2016 Sharjah prize for Like Icarus, the Mustafa Azzouz prize and the Mona El-Shazly poll after his death, the Tanta book fair in his name — each with its photograph, the book it was for and its source; then the other honours the Legacy timeline records (the tributes, the Google doodle, the Egyptian Pocket Novels salon); a band of a medal among falling confetti

New page «لقاءاته» (talks.html): his interviews and talks and the films, profiles and articles about him — the 55 the Legacy page lists — on a page of their own, filtered by kind or to the 24 videos, oldest or newest first, under year headings; the videos play on the page (youtube-nocookie, loaded only when pressed), the rest open where published; a band of a TV studio with an «on air» sign

New page «الطبعات» (editions.html): his books through the years of publishing — the pocket series' move from the Modern Arab Association to Selah El-Telmeez, with each house's years and editions, then a timeline for each of the 42 books with two or more dated Arabic editions, a dot an edition coloured by its house (matched as the book pages match it; the house's spellings merged), each naming its house and year; a band of a shelf under a moving edition stamp

New page «رحلتي» (journey.html): the reader's progress through his work from their own lists, on their device only — a ring for each series and one for his books, how much is read (a collector: owned) and what comes next, the months they added them, redrawn as the lists change, and the whole as a picture to share; an empty list shows where to begin. Not indexed, being personal; a band of rings filling in the series' colours

New page «جدار الأغلفة» (covers.html): every cover the site holds on one wall — 499, each issue's and book's and those of its other editions, once — filtered by series or the books, each opening its page; and «الأول والآن», the 32 Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a issues whose first edition the site has, the 1990s cover beside today's; a band of covers sliding past in rows

New page «على الشاشة» (screen.html): his work on screen in order — Refaat Ismail's first appearance in Amr Salama's «زي النهارده» (2008), «زودياك» (2019), «ما وراء الطبيعة» on Netflix (2020) and «الغرفة 207» (2022) — each with its poster, what and where, the book it came from, the trailer from the maker's own channel (Netflix MENA, MBC Shahid, Viu; loaded only when pressed, from youtube-nocookie) and the site's articles about it; a band of a film strip of the posters under a projector's beam

New page «حول العالم» (world.html): his books in other languages — 16 editions in 7 languages (Utopia in English, French, German, Italian and Finnish; his essays and stories in Persian and Malayalam), a shelf a language with each edition's cover, title as printed, translator, publisher, year and source, linked to the book's page; a band of «Utopia» drifting by in every script it was printed in
Bands: a page may bring its own band (PAGE.band), kept in its own script — groundwork for the new pages, so each can be removed on its own

Abjad: the «Abjjad» button on 235 book and issue pages and on the WWW series page now opens the book's own page there, not a search — every Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a, Fantasia, Safari and special issue Abjad sells, and his novels and collections, from his author page there (244 books), matched by title and, for the issues, by series and number; six Ida2at serial stories it sells singly have no book page here. A book Abjad does not sell keeps the search
Legacy videos: Medhat El-Adl's «إنت حر» on CBC Two, a whole episode with him (17 February 2015), sent by the site's editor

Legacy videos: «لقاء السحاب» (Ibrahim Eissa with him and Nabil Farouk, 2015), Bilal Fadl's «عصير الكتب» episode in his honour (2011, two parts), «عز الشباب» (2013), «عصير الكتب» on his science fiction (2018) and Al Nahar's «باب الخلق» in his memory (April 2018), sent by the site's editor; «بلدنا بالمصري» was already here
Footer: each page once — the phone menu's own entries (the four data pages and «قوائمي») are left out of the footer's list, where the data pages already stand beside the publishers
Legacy videos: «حياة وثائقية»'s 40-minute documentary on his life and work (2024), and his two-part interview with The Insider Tanta (2014, 2015), sent by the site's editor

«E.S.P» as radio drama: Dubvo's twelve-episode YouTube playlist, sent by the site's editor — on the book's page under the tape beside its Storytel audiobook, and on the audio page as a shelf of its own, the twelve episodes playing in turn
Legacy articles: «أحمد خالد توفيق: العراب الذي جعل الشباب يقرأون» by Heba Khamis in the Egyptian Researchers Magazine (19 September 2018), sent by the site's editor
Legacy videos: ReadTube («جيل يقرأ») on «يوتوبيا», a 26-minute retelling of the novel on screen (YouTube, March 2023), sent by the site's editor

The four data pages get a band above their headline, as the other pages have: «في الصحف», his papers folded on a desk under a lamp, a masthead each with his count in it, the biggest first; «بالأرقام», a scoreboard counting up to the site's totals over a rising bar chart; «اختبر نفسك», a glowing question mark over four answers, the right one lighting in turn; «الخريطة», a navigator's chart with dashed routes from Tanta to places his books name, and a compass. All four in the phone menu, after «قوائمي»; and «في الصحف» (12 outlets) and «الخريطة» (34 places) among «ادخل المكتبة» on the home page, their totals recorded by the data build since the home page loads neither the blog nor the map

New page «الخريطة» (map.html): the places his books and issues name, on a map of the world — 34 places in 33 books, issues and series, found in the site's own descriptions, back covers and titles (tools/build-places.js with the list in tools/places.js: names only, never adjectives; not where a book was published; a series' shared description pinned once to the series), each pin as big as the books that name it, opening a panel with those books and the sentence that names the place, the name marked; the same places as a list under the map; a place in the address opens on load (map.html#Romania). The world is drawn once from Natural Earth (tools/build-world.js, 83 KB) — no map library or tiles. And the four new pages in the footer beside the publishers, and in the sitemap

New page «اختبر نفسك» (quiz.html): ten questions a round, drawn from the site's data and mixed in turn — a cover and its issue, a quote and its book, a character and their series, an issue and its series, a book and its year, a description and the character — four answers each, the right one shown with a link to its page; then the score with a word on it, a new round, and the score as a picture to share or save (with a nudge to «من أين أبدأ؟» below half)

New page «بالأرقام» (numbers.html): his work counted from the site's data — the headline numbers as tiles (counted as the home page counts them), the series on one timeline from their recorded years, Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a's issues year by year by their first editions, his standalone books year by year by kind, his pieces in the papers year by year, and the publishers by how many of his books each put out; tooltips per year, validated colours with a legend, and no chart for years the data does not hold well

New page «في الصحف» (papers.html): where his columns and stories ran — 837 pieces in 12 papers, sites and magazines between 2005 and 2018, from the blog archive's record of where and when each first ran (the archive's spellings of one outlet merged). A card per outlet with its count, kind and years (the legend and the filter at once), his pieces year by year as stacked columns in validated colours with a tooltip per year, and the articles themselves by year, each linked to its page

Home: «في مثل هذا اليوم» moves under the timeline, and each moment shows its picture in the card's corner when it has one — the article's picture from the blog, a book's or an issue's cover (upright), a legacy event's photo or video frame, his portrait on the days of his birth and death (913 of the 950)

Quotes as pictures: «صورة» opens a small studio with the picture as it will be — square for a post or tall (9:16) for a story or a WhatsApp status, on paper or by night, with the book's cover when it has one (in the corner of a square, standing at the foot of a tall one), the site's address at the bottom, drawn once the fonts are loaded — and «شارك» hands it straight to the phone's apps (WhatsApp, Instagram…) where the browser allows, «تحميل» saves it as PNG

Home: «في مثل هذا اليوم» after the biography — what happened on today's date in other years: his birth or death, the legacy, books and first editions of issues on the day they came out, and his articles on the day the paper printed them (828 of them dated in the blog archive), each with its year and how long ago; six at first, the rest a button away; on a day with none, the next day that has, as «في مثل هذا الأسبوع». 950 moments on 335 days of the year, kept by month in assets/data/days/ (tools/build-days.js, run by build-sw.js) so the home page loads only its month, and offline

Share previews in JPG: the 194 share pages whose picture was a WebP now give a JPG copy of it (assets/img/share/, 188 pictures, at most 600 px wide), since WhatsApp on older phones, LinkedIn and others show no preview for WebP. Made by tools/share-jpg.py (Python with Pillow) from the share build, only for pictures new or changed since; without Pillow the WebP is kept
Blog: on a phone the big «مقالاته وقصصه القصيرة جميعًا والكوميكس التي نشرها في الصحف» heading is left out of the top section; the picture, the count and the links stay
Blog: the top section has no box of its own — no background, border or rounded frame — its heading, picture and links standing straight on the page

Writers: a «كتب عنه» filter with the six writers of the books about him — Ehab Moustafa (العرّاب), Khalaf Gaber (أسطورة أحمد خالد توفيق), Mahmoud Hafez (اسمه خالد), Dr. Islam Hamza (السخرية في أدب أحمد خالد توفيق), Engy Khaled Ahmed (اليوتوبيا والديستوبيا…) and Hany Haggag (حتى تحترق النجوم) — drawn from the books about him on the tributes page, so a new one joins by itself; each with the book's cover in the panel, «كتاب عنه: …», and a page of their own («ألّفت كتابًا عنه» for a woman)

«سوبر ميجا»: Sayed Zahran wrote in it with him too — now in «شاركوه السلسلة» on its page beside Nabil Farouk and Sally Adel, and among «كتبوا معه» on the writers page, his own page showing both what he wrote with him and his words on «البرزخ»

روايات عالمية للجيب 76, «الأفق المفقود»: its cover, sent by the site's editor — the bookshop's picture for it was the cover of #70, «ماتيلدا». Lasheen's page names its writer under «صاحب السلسلة» (it is hers, grown from his work), not «شاركوه السلسلة (1)». And every other series page has a scene of its own behind the book, as the heroes' series do: the specials, the three heroes' lights meeting; Shivers, rain and lightning; the World Pocket Novels, a turning globe; Molotov, rising embers; the Summer Book, a sun; the Adventurer, a compass and a trail; Adabiyat, ruled paper and ink; Super Mega, comic dots and a burst; Balya, bouncing marbles; the comics, panels; Lasheen, a clock at midnight — each in both themes, still when motion is reduced
IndexNow: send to Bing, which shares with the other engines; the shared api.indexnow.org refused the key (403) while Bing accepted it

English coverage: the data check's --en report now also finds «English» that is the Arabic again and narrators with no Latin spelling, skips the staging copy no page reads, and leaves the printed back-cover texts in Arabic as printed. What it found is now English: the printing house «شركة سلاح التلميذ للطباعة والنشر» (205 places) as Selah El-Telmeez; the WWW and special issues' printings take their issues' English titles; the collected volumes' labels (Safari — Volume 6, Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a box set — Volumes 9 to 16); the other «بلية العجيب» issues' titles; and the 47 Storytel and Iqraaly narrators, for «read by …» on the English pages

A data check (tools/check-data.js): pictures the data names that are not in the repo, links to books, series, characters, writers or publishers the site does not have, details kept for missing issues or books, characters tied to a missing work, duplicate ids, sources that are not web addresses, and blog excerpts whose lines ran together; --en lists text with no English yet. All 1,420 pictures and every link check out. It found blog excerpts where the feed's line breaks were lost: 105 places in 81 excerpts where a full stop or colon ran into the next word («مقتضبة.رسوم»), and eight where two words or a poem's lines ran together («إسماعيل ديابكأن», «طالعةبرغم»), now spaced, with « — » or « / »

Series pages: «عدد عشوائي», a die beside «كل الأعداد» that opens a random issue — for a reader with lists, one not yet read (a collector: one not yet owned), for a start or a next read in a series of eighty

Series pages: the reader's progress through the series, from their lists — «قرأت 5 من 80» (a collector: what is in their collection) with a bar, and the first issue not yet read (or owned) to go to next; each read or owned cover gets a check. An issue in two parts counts once. Redrawn as the lists change; hidden until one issue is in the list

Share a list as a link: each list in «قوائمي» has a share button that sends (or copies) lists.html#share=<list>/<books>, the list itself in the address — issues of a series as runs of numbers (mwt~1-20_25), other books by id, a whole series with «!» — no account or server. Opening it shows that list's covers first, read-only, with a button to add them all to the same list of one's own

IndexNow, for Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver: the site's key file at its root, and tools/indexnow.js, which sends them every address in sitemap.xml so new and changed pages are crawled without waiting (no account needed; Google takes the sitemap through Search Console instead)

Lighter pages: the eleven data files every page loaded (data.js … data-more.js) are now built into one, assets/js/data-built.js (tools/build-data.js, run first by build-sw.js) — one download instead of eleven, 907 KB instead of 1,186 KB (209 KB compressed instead of 248 KB), without AKT.more, the copy data-more.js staged its additions in, which no page read, and without the browser re-running every correction on each page. The data is still edited in those files. The service worker no longer pre-caches them; the share pages are rewritten only when they change (the folder syncs with OneDrive, which locks files). README explains the build

Shared links get their own preview: share/<kind>/<id>.html, a small page for each of the 1,536 books, issues, series, characters, writers, publishers and blog articles with its own title, description and picture in the tags WhatsApp, Facebook, X and Telegram read (they run no scripts, so every real page looked alike to them), which opens the real page at once (noindex, canonical to the real page). A «شارك» button on those pages hands out that address, through the phone's share sheet or copied. Built with the sitemap from the same data (tools/build-share.js, run by build-sw.js); the data loader the build tools share is tools/load-data.js

The special issues (سلسلة الأعداد الخاصة): all ten covers from the publisher's own store, Rewayat Masreya — the same artwork the site had, scanned clean without the later printer's stamp — now each issue's cover, and on the Modern Arab Association's print where one is listed, with the store's page among its sources

ما وراء الطبيعة: the first editions' covers for 33 issues, from the publisher's own store (Rewayat Masreya) — the original design with the owl over «روايات مصرية للجيب», each put on its issue's first-edition print (switchable under the book, and in the collector's edition picker), with the store's page among its sources; #80 part 2 gets its 2014 print. The store's other 40 LE listings show the later reprint covers the site already has, so they are left out
My lists band: no line under it — its floor fades into the page behind the crates, its edges take the page's own colour, and the headline comes up closer, as on the About and Characters pages

My lists page: a picture band above its headline, like the other pages' — four wooden crates under a hanging lamp, one per list, holding the reader's own covers (the newest in front) with the count on a brass plate; an empty crate has a cover dropping into it, as one is dragged onto a list. The current mode's two crates stand lit, the others in the shade, and the band redraws as the lists change (lists.js now announces it). Parchment and pale wood in the light theme

Search engines: a sitemap of every page (1,552 addresses: the sections, each book and issue, series, character, writer, publisher and blog article, with the covers for image search), rebuilt with the service worker from the same data.
